title: AXEL ARIGATO
subtitle: Digital Advertising & Global Growth Campaign
overview: Axel Arigato partnered with ART.DOT to architect and deploy a high-cadence digital advertising campaign across key European metropolitan hubs, driving record direct-to-consumer acquisition during peak seasonal drop windows.
challenge: Breaking through saturated luxury streetwear feed environments required moving beyond static product lookbooks. The brand needed high-velocity, narrative-driven video assets calibrated for short-form ad units that preserved elevated editorial aesthetics without sacrificing measurable ROAS.
approach: We engineered a multi-tier paid acquisition engine combining cinematic runway micro-cuts, creator styling breakdowns, and dynamic catalog retargeting. Custom attribution modeling allowed algorithmic budget reallocation toward highest-converting audience cohorts in real time.

galleryImages.caption: Sneaker silhouette visual pacing and material texture capture.
Editorial street-style framing deployed across TikTok & Meta.
Rapid iterative creative variants for seasonal drop blitz.

testimonial.quote: ART.DOT blended ruthless performance discipline with luxury sensibilities. Their creative iteration cycle allowed us to scale ad spend 4x while consistently lowering cost-per-acquisition.
testimonial.author: Marcus Lindqvist

title: SIEMATIC
subtitle: Brand Awareness & Editorial Content Strategy
overview: Repositioning iconic German luxury kitchen manufacturer SieMatic for the next generation of architectural buyers through a sleek digital-first content ecosystem.
challenge: Legacy luxury kitchen marketing has historically leaned on static catalog photography. SieMatic required an evocative, motion-rich digital presence that communicated precision engineering, bespoke craftsmanship, and timeless minimalism to younger high-net-worth homeowners and interior architects.
approach: We directed a documentary-style video series capturing the tactile materiality of SieMatic finishes in architectural spaces across London, Paris, and Berlin. Combined with an editorial digital journal, we established a distinctive architectural aesthetic that elevated brand perception across all social channels.

galleryImages.caption: Precision joinery and architectural surface interplay.
Minimalist spatial composition shot on location in Milan.
Material tactile study: smoked oak, monolithic quartz, brushed bronze.
Cinematic ambient light study in contemporary loft setting.

testimonial.quote: The work ART.DOT produced completely transformed how architects and private clients perceive our modern product lines. It set a new benchmark for architectural storytelling.
testimonial.author: Elena Rossi

title: CARSICKO
subtitle: Community Growth & Cultural Activation
overview: Igniting UK streetwear powerhouse CARSICKO with an explosive grassroots creator activation and guerilla pop-up campaign that sold out 3 consecutive collection drops within minutes.
challenge: In an oversaturated streetwear landscape driven by hype cycles, CARSICKO needed to build deep, authentic subcultural resonance rather than transactional influencer promotion, turning casual fans into loyal brand disciples.
approach: We curated a private network of 120+ underground UK musicians, skateboarders, and visual artists for synchronized unannounced drop reveals. Coupled with geofenced scavenger hunts across central London, we turned each release into an electric community event.

galleryImages.caption: Guerilla lookbook shoot in underground London metro setting.
High-octane neon night photography for collection teaser.
Pop-up event documentation: 800+ queue on Brewer Street.
Exclusive seeding kit unboxing series that drove organic TikTok virality.

testimonial.quote: ART.DOT doesn't just understand internet culture—they shape it. Every single activation they ran for us turned into an immediate viral cultural moment.
testimonial.author: Kofi Mensah

title: SOUTHWESTSIX
subtitle: Experiential Launch & Social Momentum
overview: A multisensory experiential launch event and digital momentum campaign introducing Fulham's newest members' club and private dining establishment.
challenge: Launching an exclusive private venue in West London required generating immense exclusivity and buzz without feeling generic or elitist, attracting premier tastemakers across arts, tech, and entertainment.
approach: We designed an invite-only preview weekend featuring bespoke audio-visual spatial mapping, Michelin-star culinary pairings, and live musical performances, documented by discreet editorial cinematographers for targeted social distribution.
